sentences.text: Coram: Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Moksha Khajuria Kazmi, Judge

In the instant petition, the petitioners are aggrieved of order dated 20.07.2023 passed by respondent No.1 by virtue of which the appeal against the mutation No. 648, dated 28.08.1981,
under Section 4 of the Agrarian Reforms Act and mutation No. 1414 dated 13.03.2010 under Section 8 of the Agrarian Reforms Act with respect to the land measuring 21 kanals 01 marlas comprising Khasra No. 471 situated at Village Gran, Tehsil and District Reasi has been dismissed.

Mrs. Monika Kohli, learned Sr. AAG accepts notice on behalf of respondent Nos. 1 and 2 and Mr.
Sandeep Gupta, Advocate accepts notice on behalf of respondent Nos. 3 and 10.
Notice shall go to the rest of the respondents, returnable within a period of four weeks.
Requisite steps for service within one week.
